entries.title: I Chronicles 18:1
segments: ¶After this it came to pass that David attacked the Philistines, subdued them, and took Gath and its towns from the hand of the Philistines.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:2
segments: Then he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became David's servants, [and] brought tribute.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:3
segments: And David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah [as far as] Hamath, as he went to establish his power by the River Euphrates.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:4
segments: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. And David also hamstrung all the chariot [horses], except that he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:5
segments: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:6
segments: Then David put [garrisons] in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, [and] brought tribute. So the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:7
segments: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:8
segments: Also from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadadezer, David brought a large amount of bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze Sea, the pillars, and the articles of bronze.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:9
segments: ¶Now when Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:10
segments: he sent Hadoram his son to King David, to greet him and bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him (for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou); and [Hadoram brought with him] all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:11
segments: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold that he had brought from all [these] nations-from Edom, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:12
segments: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:13
segments: He also put garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites became David's servants. And the LORD preserved David wherever he went.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:14
segments: So David reigned over all Israel, and administered judgment and justice to all his people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:15
segments: Joab the son of Zeruiah [was] over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud [was] recorder;

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:16
segments: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar [were] the priests; Shavsha [was] the scribe;

entries.title: I Chronicles 18:17
segments: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [was] over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons [were] chief ministers at the king's side.
